turns.text: Hey Deb, long time no talk. A lot's happened! On Friday I had a breakthrough with my engineering project. Finally found a solution to a prob that's been bugging me. Feels great to see my hard work paying off.
You've really proven your skills. Feels great, right? Keep it up! And I bought new props for the yoga class! Here it is in action.
Oh, I also have new details for this case! Rate it!
That`s cool! I also bought this candle for the atmosphere and to improve my yoga practice. How about you? When you do it, what feelings do you get?
I feel relaxed during this activity. I love creating a serene space with soothing scents like lavender and rosemary. Do you have any favorite scents or rituals for when you do it?

I'm also a big fan of scents like this! Candles and essential oils add warmth and calm to my yoga session. It's amazing how certain smells can transport you to a place of peace.  Do you have any other ways to enhance your yoga practice?
I find music helps me. Any favorite tracks?

I find instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms help create a peaceful vibe. One of my favorites is a track called "Savana." What songs/artists do you like listening to during your practice?

I love listening to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds during my practice. Their music is so calming and puts me in a different headspace. Do you have any recommendations for other similar artists or tracks I should check out?
Also, I'm listening to an album called 'Sleep,' which is great for meditation and deep relaxation. Hope you find it as calming as I do!
Thanks for the tips, Deborah! I'm gonna check them out. It's always good to have some new tunes for yoga!
Let me know your thoughts on the albums!
Take care and keep up the good work!

branches.label: Yoga props, candles, and calming scents
